verdict.rationale: Maritime's own docs say it ships official TypeScript and Python SDKs. They are backed by dedicated SDK doc pages for quickstart (idempotent `provision`), authentication scopes, agent messaging and webhooks, and the Files API is said to be covered by both SDKs. missing for 10: SDK package names or install instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs, and an SDK versioning or deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Give every one of your users their own agent with the TypeScript or Python SDK.
The Maritime Files API: eight endpoints and both SDKs to browse, upload, download, and edit an agent's disk over HTTP, even while the agent sleeps.
provision is idempotent on it: it returns the existing agent if there is one, else creates a new one. Safe to call on every sign-in.
Send a message and wait for the reply. Sleeping agents wake automatically.
